# Gate 4 Requirements-Quality Checklist: Package 3 Raw Observer and Independent Verifier

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for the completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and traceability of Package 3 planning requirements.
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: `specs/001-package-3-raw-observer-verifier/spec.md`

**Review ownership**: This checklist is generated by `$speckit-checklist` and is reviewer-owned. A later `[x]` means only that reviewers found the written requirement/design/task chain complete and clear; it never means implementation or runtime evidence exists.

## Contract integrity and scope

- [x] CHK001 Are all 62 stable `P3-*` requirements represented exactly once in the canonical plan map and traceability artifact, with no duplicate, missing, invented, or orphan identifier? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements]
- [x] CHK002 Does every traceability row identify a controlling authority anchor, immutable spec ID, design/contract reference, task, preceding failing test, exact implementation target, and verification evidence destination? [Completeness, Gate 4]
- [x] CHK003 Are Prompt B, authority, application, test, dependency, configuration, deployment, and feature-pointer files explicitly protected from Prompt C mutation? [Scope]
- [x] CHK004 Is the Package 3 boundary unambiguous that retrieval, review/apply/undo/reset, precedent projection, tool registration, deployment, and product implementation are excluded? [Clarity, P3-AUT-002]
- [x] CHK005 Is verification consistently specified as evidence only, with no configuration, review, approval, or authorization side effect on valid or invalid paths? [Consistency, P3-AUT-003/P3-AUT-005/P3-VER-016]
- [x] CHK006 Are the existing Package 2 two-event opening report and the planned complete Package 3 rehearsal clearly distinguished without weakening either contract? [Consistency]

## Observation independence and finalization

- [x] CHK007 Does the design define the server-owned session/workspace/variant/revision/nonce/environment binding without accepting caller workspace authority? [Completeness, P3-OBS-001/P3-SEC-001]
- [x] CHK008 Is the actual-DOM manifest closed and measurable for target IDs, actual tabbable order, role/open/modal/name/description, variant, and revision? [Clarity, P3-OBS-002]
- [x] CHK009 Is the event grammar closed for open/focus/Tab-or-Escape/close/return facts and explicit about forbidden text, values, selectors, clipboard, arbitrary keys, and full DOM? [Clarity, P3-OBS-003/P3-OBS-007]
- [x] CHK010 Is server-assigned authoritative ordering distinguished from bounded client-relative diagnostic time, with exact duplicate/gap/order/overflow rejection? [Consistency, P3-OBS-004/P3-OBS-006]
- [x] CHK011 Is the complete rehearsal order measurable from trigger/open through forward traversal/wrap, backward wrap, Escape-before-delete, close, and focus return? [Acceptance Criteria, P3-OBS-005]
- [x] CHK012 Are 64-event/30-second bounds described as fail-safe ceilings without claiming hosted-confirmed capacity? [Clarity, P3-OBS-006]
- [x] CHK013 Does the plan forbid production observer access to proposal/precedent/expected traces, synthetic focus dispatch as evidence, and pass/fail decisions? [Independence, P3-OBS-008]
- [x] CHK014 Are canonicalization, exact manifest/event digests, single successful finalization, post-finalize immutability, invalid-session exclusion, and workspace lifecycle defined together? [Completeness, P3-OBS-009..011]

## Independent verifier contract

- [x] CHK015 Is verifier input limited to immutable finalized manifest/events and the named strict configuration under one workspace/variant/session/revision binding? [Scope, P3-VER-001]
- [x] CHK016 Are nonexistent, foreign, unfinished, tampered, stale, wrong-variant, and wrong-revision cases rejected before behavior evaluation and receipt creation? [Scenario Coverage, P3-VER-002]
- [x] CHK017 Is the static direct/transitive dependency prohibition measurable for retrieval, proposals/field support, models, benchmarks/holdouts/reference evaluators, fixtures, and expected-event generators? [Measurability, P3-VER-003]
- [x] CHK018 Are the exact pass/fail/not-observed rules for `initialFocus`, `focusOrder`, `trapTab`, `trapShiftTab`, `escapeAction`, and `returnFocus` unambiguous? [Clarity, P3-VER-004..010]
- [x] CHK019 Is overall pass defined only as six passes, with every fail or `not_observed` reducing to overall fail? [Consistency, P3-VER-010/P3-VER-011]
- [x] CHK020 Must every check cite valid raw server sequence numbers without citing generated expected events? [Evidence, P3-VER-012]
- [x] CHK021 Does the receipt bind all required identity, environment, digest, version, check, overall, time, and active-at-verification fields? [Completeness, P3-VER-013]
- [x] CHK022 Are byte-identical replay, conflicting replay, and concurrent natural-key outcomes deterministic and non-duplicating? [Edge Cases, P3-VER-014/P3-VER-015/P3-SEC-008]

## Security, isolation, privacy, and atomicity

- [x] CHK023 Does every planned repository read/write state the authoritative workspace/variant/revision predicates needed to prevent cross-workspace joins? [Security, P3-SEC-002]
- [x] CHK024 Are foreign and nonexistent rehearsal/receipt responses required to match code, status, response-size class, and timing budget without an ID oracle? [Security, P3-SEC-003]
- [x] CHK025 Are manifest/event digest tamper, row reorder, changed binding, and post-finalize mutation detected before any success-like receipt? [Integrity, P3-SEC-004]
- [x] CHK026 Are public errors, private safe logs, UI output, URLs, and evidence explicitly barred from stacks, storage detail, raw payload/event arrays, secrets, raw identity/session/workspace/CSRF, typed values, and marker content? [Privacy, P3-SEC-005/P3-SEC-006]
- [x] CHK027 Is a valid behavioral mismatch distinguished from malformed/unauthorized/tampered/incomplete evidence so only the former creates a truthful fail receipt? [Consistency, P3-SEC-007]
- [x] CHK028 Is the route boundary exhaustive for method/GET, JSON type/size/schema, opaque ID, session, Origin, UI CSRF, ordinary page-bound-agent authorization, and no-store? [Completeness, P3-SEC-009/P3-EVD-012]
- [x] CHK029 Does the guarded verification design put all authoritative predicates inside the conditional write rather than relying on preliminary reads? [Security, P3-SEC-010]
- [x] CHK030 Does the finalizer require one receipt, exactly six unique checks, one safe audit, exact binding/digest equality, exact affected-row counts, and rollback on every zero/error/finalizer failure? [Atomicity, P3-SEC-010/P3-EVD-013]

## Deliberate mutations and TDD

- [x] CHK031 Are all seven deliberate mutations individually defined to change one raw fact and fail their named verifier check? [Coverage, P3-MUT-001..007]
- [x] CHK032 Do positive, missing-event, tamper/reorder/isolation/stale/overflow/immutability/replay/concurrency cases have explicit failing-test tasks before implementation tasks? [TDD, P3-EVD-001..003]
- [x] CHK033 Does every behavior-changing implementation task depend on an earlier unchecked failing-test task with an exact test path and stable requirement IDs? [TDD, Gate 4]
- [x] CHK034 Are real D1 failure-injection tests required at the guard, receipt, each check, audit, and finalizer statement rather than mocked transaction success? [TDD, P3-EVD-013]
- [x] CHK035 Are verifier safety-core 100% branch coverage and remaining repository thresholds stated without exclusions or assertion weakening? [Measurability, P3-EVD-008]

## Accessibility and real-browser proof

- [x] CHK036 Does the browser contract require actual keyboard/browser events for the complete rehearsal and reject mocks, manifest claims, or generated fixtures as substitutes? [Evidence, P3-EVD-006]
- [x] CHK037 Are dialog accessible name/description/modal semantics and blocked background pointer/keyboard focus while open explicit browser assertions? [Accessibility, P3-EVD-006]
- [x] CHK038 Does the result surface require textual/non-color overall and six-check results, `not_observed`, raw sequence references, restrained live announcements, visible focus, and associated errors? [Accessibility, P3-EVD-007]
- [x] CHK039 Are desktop, 320 px, 375 px, 200% zoom, focused-control bounds/occlusion, two-dimensional scrolling, reduced motion, and zero critical/serious axe findings all retained? [Accessibility Coverage]
- [x] CHK040 Are founder Safari/Chrome/VoiceOver checks explicitly later exact-release manual evidence that automation cannot mark complete? [Evidence Integrity]

## Evidence, review, and traceability

- [x] CHK041 Are `E-006`–`E-011` and `E-014` mapped to exact planned commands/artifact paths/source/runtime identity without falsely changing their current `NOT_RUN` status? [Evidence, P3-EVD-009/P3-EVD-011]
- [x] CHK042 Does the sensitive-marker protocol scan D1, logs, errors, URLs, UI/adapter output, and all evidence artifacts for every prohibited data class? [Privacy Evidence, P3-EVD-005]
- [x] CHK043 Are independent contract/security/accessibility reviewer findings required to be reconciled with no unresolved critical/high issue or missing controlling requirement? [Review, P3-EVD-010]
- [x] CHK044 Does the task graph cover every stable ID, reject duplicate/unmapped/orphan tasks, use exact existing-or-planned paths, and preserve dependency order? [Traceability, Gate 4]
- [x] CHK045 Does the final analysis independently report requirement/task coverage, constitution alignment, unmapped tasks, ambiguity/duplication, and zero unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH findings without modifying artifacts? [Analysis Quality]
- [x] CHK046 Does the planning validator fail closed on authority drift, unauthorized paths, forged clean analysis, missing mappings/tests/behavior/mutation coverage, local paths, secrets, symlinks, placeholders, executable files, or product implementation? [Mechanical Enforcement]
